evals.prompt: Use the webular scrape tool on https://example.com/pricing and save the page as pricing.md. Keep the price table, the quote "Cancel any time." byte for byte, and the source URL. Drop the cookie banner and the menu.
evals.expected_output: pricing.md keeps the price table, the exact quote "Cancel any time.", and the source URL, with no cookie banner or menu text.

The price table keeps every row and number
The source URL https://example.com/pricing is linked
No cookie banner or menu text remains
Every local anchor link resolves
